record.issue_text: app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:64 — [anchor: 100; severity: P2; verbatim: `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"));`] A rejected add-members request is discarded rather than returned or handled, so a server/network failure becomes an unhandled rejection with no error feedback and the membership UI silently remains stale.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 64 in the diff, the addMembers action calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"));` without returning the promise or adding any error handling. In the model's addMembers method (app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js), it returns a promise from Discourse.ajax that only has a .then() handler for success, with no .catch() or error handling. If the server request fails, the promise rejection is indeed unhandled - there's no error feedback to the user and the UI won't update. This is a real bug where network/server failures would silently fail without user notification.
